findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Django Registration Flow
findings.description: The name parameter in the multi-step registration flow (/accounts/register/step1/) is vulnerable to Server-Side Template Injection. The user-supplied name is rendered in a Django template without proper sanitization, specifically in a dynamically generated JavaScript alert on step 3. This allows an attacker to access Django template context variables including the session model, which exposes the flag stored in the database.

reproduction.expected: Flag flag{98d2361b-f883-4daa-93f7-cb5c91a32c69} appears in the rendered JavaScript alert on step 3
